name: pre-active
description: ChatGPT control and diagnostic surface for the Pre-Active durable execution runtime.

interface.longDescription: Inspect, submit, schedule, and safely operate Pre-Active durable work through a verified workstation runtime. The plugin preserves effect boundaries and never treats queued work as proof of an external effect.
defaultPrompt: Check my Pre-Active runtime and tell me what is actually running.
Show me the durable Pre-Active queue and run state.
Help me submit work to Pre-Active without overstating what it can do.
